## Description

Combines rough path signature tensor embeddings with Neural Delay Differential Equations to solve multi-period stochastic optimal control portfolio problems under delayed macro information transmission.

## Where it may fit

Central bank policy transmission lags, multi-period asset allocation with memory effects, institutional portfolio rebalancing.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Global Macro Hedge Funds, Pension Portfolios.

## Required data

Multi-asset historical return series, policy announcement lag schedules, volatility surfaces.

## Caveats

Signature tensor expansion and delay ODE solving require high-performance GPU acceleration.
